issue.body:
# Bug Report: 

This bug is triggered by the HLO-to-StableHLO conversion: the HLO module runs successfully via `run_hlo_module --input_format=hlo`, and the conversion via `hlo-translate --hlo-to-mlir` also succeeds, but running the translated StableHLO via `run_hlo_module --input_format=stablehlo` fails with:

> `Check failed: false Mesh not found with name: @mesh`

## Environment

- **XLA commit**: `5ce7908a2d32a9f91fd99380435cda1b645c8cc7`
- **CPU**: `Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-14900HX`
- **GPU**: `NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU`
- **CUDA Driver**: `580.126.09`

## run_hlo_module (HLO) — Success

**HLO:**

```
HloModule jit_matmul, entry_computation_layout={(f64[8,3]{1,0}, f64[])->f64[8,3]{1,0}}, allow_spmd_sharding_propagation_to_parameters={false,true}, allow_spmd_sharding_propagation_to_output={true}, num_partitions=2

ENTRY main.4 {
  Arg_1.2 = f64[] parameter(1)
  Arg_0.1 = f64[8,3]{1,0} parameter(0), frontend_attributes={xla.sdy.sharding="#sdy.sharding<@mesh, [{\"x\"}, {}]>"}
  ROOT dot.3 = f64[8,3]{1,0} dot(Arg_1.2, Arg_0.1), lhs_contracting_dims={}, rhs_contracting_dims={}
}
```

**Execution Command:**

```bash
run_hlo_module \
  --platform=CPU \
  --reference_platform= \
  --input_format=hlo \
  jit_matmul_204e03cb_264.hlo
```

**Output:**

```

 ** Running jit_matmul_204e03cb_264.hlo** 
Running HLO module with runner Host...
WARNING: All log messages before absl::InitializeLog() is called are written to STDERR
W0000 00:00:1774416776.601833 2088203 sharding_propagation.cc:3127] GSPMD sharding propagation is going to be deprecated and not supported in the future. Please consider migrating to Shardy (https://openxla.org/shardy). For reference, Shardy is already the default partitioner in JAX.
... compiled and ran in 0.0202754s.
Skipping reference runner

```

## run_hlo_module (StableHLO) — FAIL

**Translation Command:**

```bash
hlo-translate \
  --hlo-to-mlir \
  jit_matmul_204e03cb_264.hlo \
  -o \
  jit_matmul_204e03cb_264.mlir
```

**IR After Translation:**

```mlir
module @jit_matmul attributes {mhlo.cross_program_prefetches = [], mhlo.input_output_alias = [], mhlo.is_dynamic = false, mhlo.num_partitions = 2 : i32, mhlo.use_auto_spmd_partitioning = false} {
  func.func @main(%arg0: tensor<8x3xf64> {mhlo.frontend_attributes = {xla.sdy.sharding = "#sdy.sharding<@mesh, [{\22x\22}, {}]>"}}, %arg1: tensor<f64>) -> tensor<8x3xf64> {
    %0 = stablehlo.dot_general %arg1, %arg0, contracting_dims = [] x [], precision = [DEFAULT, DEFAULT] : (tensor<f64>, tensor<8x3xf64>) -> tensor<8x3xf64>
    return %0 : tensor<8x3xf64>
  }
}
```

**Execution Command:**

```bash
run_hlo_module \
  --platform=CPU \
  --reference_platform= \
  --input_format=stablehlo \
  jit_matmul_204e03cb_264.mlir
```

**Output:**

```
WARNING: All log messages before absl::InitializeLog() is called are written to STDERR
F0000 00:00:1774416776.759954 2088303 attribute_exporter.cc:71] Check failed: false Mesh not found with name: @mesh
*** Check failure stack trace: ***
    @     0x61632784c4f4  absl::lts_20250814::log_internal::LogMessage::SendToLog()
    @     0x61632784c476  absl::lts_20250814::log_internal::LogMessage::Flush()
    @     0x61631f311665  std::_Function_handler<>::_M_invoke()
    @     0x61631f311ab5  xla::sdy::convertToHloSharding()
    @     0x61631f310cb8  xla::(anonymous namespace)::CreateOpShardingFromSdySharding()
    @     0x61631f310c20  xla::ExtractShardyArgShardingFromFrontendAttrs()
    @     0x61631f1e4e10  mlir::(anonymous namespace)::ConvertToHloModule::RunOnFunction()

    @     0x61631d9f09cc  xla::MlirHloToHloTextTranslateFunction()
```
